```{r ammonia_setup}
# ---- Ammonia mapping setup ----
# This workflow creates school-level NAEI NH3 emissions context variables.
# It does not alter analysis_core_objects.RData.
# It assumes the main SAMHE/AURN datasets have already been loaded.

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(stringr)
library(viridis)

project_root <- "/Users/richardbeaumont/R_projects/1st_Paper"

ammonia_dir <- file.path(project_root, "contextual_mapping", "ammonia_mapping")
ammonia_raw_dir <- file.path(ammonia_dir, "raw_data")
ammonia_processed_dir <- file.path(ammonia_dir, "processed_data")
ammonia_fig_dir <- file.path(ammonia_dir, "figures")

dir.create(ammonia_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(ammonia_raw_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(ammonia_processed_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(ammonia_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sheffield_purple <- "#7A1FA2"
defra_orange <- "#E57200"
```

```{r check_approved_samhe_datasets}
# ---- Check approved SAMHE/AURN datasets ----
# The ammonia workflow uses the existing screened SAMHE/AURN datasets directly:
# In_Out_24, In_Out_SchHrs, and In_Out_OutSchHrs.
# No additional school-level exclusion rule is applied here.

required_objects <- c(
  "In_Out_24",
  "In_Out_SchHrs",
  "In_Out_OutSchHrs"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !required_objects %in% ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required SAMHE/AURN datasets are not loaded: ",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

required_columns <- c(
  "SchoolId_short",
  "SchoolLongitude",
  "SchoolLatitude",
  "DateTime",
  "pm02",
  "pm2.5"
)

for (object_name in required_objects) {
  
  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(get(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv))
  )
  
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      object_name,
      " is missing required column(s): ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
}
```

```{r import_naei_nh3_2023_rasters}
# ---- Import NAEI NH3 2023 GeoTIFF layers ----
# NAEI 2023 is used as the NH3 emissions/source-pressure context layer.

naei_year <- 2023

naei_nh3_folder <- file.path(
  ammonia_raw_dir,
  "naei23_nh3_2023",
  "GeoTIFF_layers"
)

naei_nh3_files <- list.files(
  naei_nh3_folder,
  pattern = "\\.tif$|\\.tiff$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

naei_nh3_inventory <- tibble(
  file_path = naei_nh3_files,
  file_name = basename(naei_nh3_files)
) %>%
  mutate(
    sector = case_when(
      str_detect(file_name, "^01energyprod") ~ "01energyprod",
      str_detect(file_name, "^02nonindustcomb") ~ "02nonindustcomb",
      str_detect(file_name, "^03industcomb") ~ "03industcomb",
      str_detect(file_name, "^04prodprocess") ~ "04prodprocess",
      str_detect(file_name, "^05offshore") ~ "05offshore",
      str_detect(file_name, "^06solvents") ~ "06solvents",
      str_detect(file_name, "^07roadtrans") ~ "07roadtrans",
      str_detect(file_name, "^08othertrans") ~ "08othertrans",
      str_detect(file_name, "^09waste") ~ "09waste",
      str_detect(file_name, "^10agriculture") ~ "10agriculture",
      str_detect(file_name, "^11nature") ~ "11nature",
      str_detect(file_name, "^total") ~ "total",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sector != "unknown"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    sector
  )

naei_nh3_inventory

if (nrow(naei_nh3_inventory) == 0) {
  stop("No NAEI NH3 GeoTIFF files found in: ", naei_nh3_folder)
}

naei_nh3_rasters <- terra::rast(
  naei_nh3_inventory$file_path
)

names(naei_nh3_rasters) <- naei_nh3_inventory$sector

naei_nh3_rasters

naei_nh3_metadata <- tibble(
  year = naei_year,
  sector = names(naei_nh3_rasters),
  nrow = terra::nrow(naei_nh3_rasters),
  ncol = terra::ncol(naei_nh3_rasters),
  crs = terra::crs(naei_nh3_rasters),
  xmin = terra::ext(naei_nh3_rasters)[1],
  xmax = terra::ext(naei_nh3_rasters)[2],
  ymin = terra::ext(naei_nh3_rasters)[3],
  ymax = terra::ext(naei_nh3_rasters)[4]
)

naei_nh3_metadata

saveRDS(
  naei_nh3_inventory,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "naei_nh3_2023_file_inventory.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  naei_nh3_metadata,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "naei_nh3_2023_metadata.rds")
)
```

```{r extract_naei_nh3_school_buffers}
# ---- Extract NAEI NH3 emissions at schools and within buffers ----
# Uses school coordinates already present in In_Out_SchHrs.
# Creates school-level ammonia context tables.
# Does not alter the SAMHE/AURN datasets.
# The gridcell value is the NAEI raster cell containing the school.
# The 1, 2, 5, and 10 km values are mean raster values within circular buffers.

naei_year <- 2023

ammonia_extraction <- local({

  # ---- One coordinate row per school ----

  school_coordinates <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      SchoolLongitude,
      SchoolLatitude
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(SchoolLongitude),
      !is.na(SchoolLatitude)
    ) %>%
    group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
    summarise(
      SchoolLongitude = first(SchoolLongitude),
      SchoolLatitude = first(SchoolLatitude),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ---- Convert school coordinates to spatial points ----

  school_coordinates_sf <- school_coordinates %>%
    st_as_sf(
      coords = c("SchoolLongitude", "SchoolLatitude"),
      crs = 4326,
      remove = FALSE
    )

  # ---- Transform school points to NAEI raster CRS ----

  school_coordinates_bng <- st_transform(
    school_coordinates_sf,
    crs = terra::crs(naei_nh3_rasters)
  )

  school_vect <- terra::vect(
    school_coordinates_bng
  )

  # ---- Gridcell extraction ----

  nh3_gridcell_extract <- terra::extract(
    naei_nh3_rasters,
    school_vect
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    select(-ID)

  nh3_gridcell_values <- bind_cols(
    school_coordinates %>%
      select(SchoolId_short),
    tibble(buffer_km = 0),
    nh3_gridcell_extract
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(SchoolId_short, buffer_km),
      names_to = "sector",
      values_to = "nh3_emission_value"
    )

  # ---- Buffer extraction ----

  buffer_distances_m <- c(
    1000,
    2000,
    5000,
    10000
  )

  extract_buffer_mean <- function(buffer_m) {
    
    school_buffers <- terra::buffer(
      school_vect,
      width = buffer_m
    )
    
    buffer_extract <- terra::extract(
      naei_nh3_rasters,
      school_buffers,
      fun = mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      select(-ID)
    
    bind_cols(
      school_coordinates %>%
        select(SchoolId_short),
      tibble(buffer_km = buffer_m / 1000),
      buffer_extract
    ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -c(SchoolId_short, buffer_km),
        names_to = "sector",
        values_to = "nh3_emission_value"
      )
  }

  nh3_buffer_values <- bind_rows(
    lapply(buffer_distances_m, extract_buffer_mean)
  )

  # ---- Combine gridcell and buffer values ----

  school_ammonia_context_long <- bind_rows(
    nh3_gridcell_values,
    nh3_buffer_values
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = naei_year,
      sector_label = case_when(
        sector == "02nonindustcomb" ~ "02 Non-industrial combustion",
        sector == "03industcomb" ~ "03 Industrial combustion",
        sector == "04prodprocess" ~ "04 Production processes",
        sector == "06solvents" ~ "06 Solvents",
        sector == "07roadtrans" ~ "07 Road transport",
        sector == "08othertrans" ~ "08 Other transport",
        sector == "09waste" ~ "09 Waste",
        sector == "10agriculture" ~ "10 Agriculture",
        sector == "11nature" ~ "11 Nature",
        sector == "total" ~ "Total",
        TRUE ~ sector
      )
    )

  # ---- Wide version for joining later ----

  school_ammonia_context_wide <- school_ammonia_context_long %>%
    mutate(
      variable_name = paste0(
        "nh3_",
        sector,
        "_",
        ifelse(buffer_km == 0, "gridcell", paste0(buffer_km, "km"))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      variable_name,
      nh3_emission_value
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = variable_name,
      values_from = nh3_emission_value
    )

  list(
    school_coordinates = school_coordinates,
    school_ammonia_context_long = school_ammonia_context_long,
    school_ammonia_context_wide = school_ammonia_context_wide
  )
})

school_coordinates <- ammonia_extraction$school_coordinates
school_ammonia_context_long <- ammonia_extraction$school_ammonia_context_long
school_ammonia_context_wide <- ammonia_extraction$school_ammonia_context_wide

rm(ammonia_extraction)

saveRDS(
  school_ammonia_context_long,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "school_ammonia_context_long.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  school_ammonia_context_wide,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "school_ammonia_context_wide.rds")
)

school_ammonia_context_long %>%
  count(
    sector,
    buffer_km
  )

school_ammonia_context_wide
```

```{r create_ammonia_pm25_results}
# ---- Create one clean NH3-PM2.5 analysis object ----
# Uses only the already-screened SAMHE/AURN datasets:
# In_Out_24, In_Out_SchHrs, and In_Out_OutSchHrs.
# No additional school-level exclusion criteria are applied.
# Creates one main object: ammonia_pm25_results.

ammonia_pm25_results <- local({

  # ---- Add gridded-sector NH3 sum, excluding NAEI total ----
  # This avoids mixing sector rasters with the NAEI total layer,
  # because the total layer also includes point-source emissions.

  school_ammonia_sector_sum_wide <- school_ammonia_context_long %>%
    filter(
      sector != "total"
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      SchoolId_short,
      buffer_km
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      nh3_emission_value = sum(nh3_emission_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      variable_name = paste0(
        "nh3_gridded_sector_sum_",
        ifelse(buffer_km == 0, "gridcell", paste0(buffer_km, "km"))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      variable_name,
      nh3_emission_value
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = variable_name,
      values_from = nh3_emission_value
    )

  school_ammonia_context_wide_extended <- school_ammonia_context_wide %>%
    left_join(
      school_ammonia_sector_sum_wide,
      by = "SchoolId_short"
    )

  # ---- Function to summarise each approved SAMHE/AURN dataset ----

  summarise_pm25_by_school <- function(data, period_label) {
    
    data %>%
      group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
      summarise(
        indoor_pm25_mean = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
        indoor_pm25_median = median(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
        outdoor_pm25_mean = mean(`pm2.5`, na.rm = TRUE),
        outdoor_pm25_median = median(`pm2.5`, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_observations = n(),
        n_days = n_distinct(as.Date(DateTime)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        period = period_label,
        io_ratio_mean = indoor_pm25_mean / outdoor_pm25_mean,
        io_ratio_median = indoor_pm25_median / outdoor_pm25_median
      )
  }

  # ---- Summarise approved SAMHE/AURN datasets and join NH3 context ----

  school_pm25_ammonia <- bind_rows(
    summarise_pm25_by_school(In_Out_24, "All hours"),
    summarise_pm25_by_school(In_Out_SchHrs, "School hours"),
    summarise_pm25_by_school(In_Out_OutSchHrs, "Out of school hours")
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      school_ammonia_context_wide_extended,
      by = "SchoolId_short"
    )

  # ---- NH3 variables to test ----

  ammonia_variables <- c(
    "nh3_total_1km",
    "nh3_total_2km",
    "nh3_total_5km",
    "nh3_total_10km",
    "nh3_gridded_sector_sum_1km",
    "nh3_gridded_sector_sum_2km",
    "nh3_gridded_sector_sum_5km",
    "nh3_gridded_sector_sum_10km",
    "nh3_10agriculture_1km",
    "nh3_10agriculture_2km",
    "nh3_10agriculture_5km",
    "nh3_10agriculture_10km"
  )

  ammonia_variables <- ammonia_variables[
    ammonia_variables %in% names(school_pm25_ammonia)
  ]

  # ---- Correlation analysis ----

  correlation_results <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      unique(school_pm25_ammonia$period),
      function(period_name) {
        
        period_data <- school_pm25_ammonia %>%
          filter(period == period_name)
        
        bind_rows(
          lapply(
            ammonia_variables,
            function(ammonia_var) {
              
              test_data <- period_data %>%
                select(
                  nh3_value = all_of(ammonia_var),
                  indoor_pm25_mean,
                  indoor_pm25_median,
                  outdoor_pm25_mean,
                  outdoor_pm25_median,
                  io_ratio_mean,
                  io_ratio_median
                ) %>%
                filter(
                  is.finite(nh3_value),
                  is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
                  is.finite(indoor_pm25_median),
                  is.finite(outdoor_pm25_mean),
                  is.finite(outdoor_pm25_median),
                  is.finite(io_ratio_mean),
                  is.finite(io_ratio_median)
                )
              
              indoor_mean_test <- cor.test(
                test_data$nh3_value,
                test_data$indoor_pm25_mean,
                method = "spearman",
                exact = FALSE
              )
              
              indoor_median_test <- cor.test(
                test_data$nh3_value,
                test_data$indoor_pm25_median,
                method = "spearman",
                exact = FALSE
              )
              
              outdoor_mean_test <- cor.test(
                test_data$nh3_value,
                test_data$outdoor_pm25_mean,
                method = "spearman",
                exact = FALSE
              )
              
              io_mean_test <- cor.test(
                test_data$nh3_value,
                test_data$io_ratio_mean,
                method = "spearman",
                exact = FALSE
              )
              
              tibble(
                period = period_name,
                ammonia_variable = ammonia_var,
                n_schools = nrow(test_data),
                rho_indoor_pm25_mean = unname(indoor_mean_test$estimate),
                p_indoor_pm25_mean = indoor_mean_test$p.value,
                rho_indoor_pm25_median = unname(indoor_median_test$estimate),
                p_indoor_pm25_median = indoor_median_test$p.value,
                rho_outdoor_pm25_mean = unname(outdoor_mean_test$estimate),
                p_outdoor_pm25_mean = outdoor_mean_test$p.value,
                rho_io_ratio_mean = unname(io_mean_test$estimate),
                p_io_ratio_mean = io_mean_test$p.value
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  ) %>%
    arrange(
      period,
      p_indoor_pm25_mean
    )

  list(
    school_ammonia_context_wide_extended = school_ammonia_context_wide_extended,
    school_pm25_ammonia = school_pm25_ammonia,
    correlations = correlation_results
  )
})

saveRDS(
  ammonia_pm25_results,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "ammonia_pm25_results.rds")
)

ammonia_pm25_results$correlations
```

```{r map_samhe_schools_nh3_1km}
# ---- Map of SAMHE schools coloured by local NH3 emissions ----
# This version uses the extracted NAEI 2023 "total" NH3 emissions value
# within 1 km of each school.

library(rnaturalearth)

# One row per school with coordinates
school_coordinates <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  select(
    SchoolId_short,
    SchoolLongitude,
    SchoolLatitude
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SchoolLongitude),
    !is.na(SchoolLatitude)
  ) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    SchoolLongitude = first(SchoolLongitude),
    SchoolLatitude = first(SchoolLatitude),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join coordinates to extracted NH3 values
nh3_map_data <- school_ammonia_context_long %>%
  filter(
    sector == "total",
    buffer_km == 1
  ) %>%
  select(
    SchoolId_short,
    nh3_emission_value
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    school_coordinates,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SchoolLongitude),
    !is.na(SchoolLatitude),
    !is.na(nh3_emission_value)
  )

# Convert to sf
nh3_map_sf <- st_as_sf(
  nh3_map_data,
  coords = c("SchoolLongitude", "SchoolLatitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

# UK basemap
uk_map <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(
  country = "United Kingdom",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

# Plot
nh3_school_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = uk_map,
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = nh3_map_sf,
    aes(colour = nh3_emission_value),
    size = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-8.5, 2.5),
    ylim = c(49.5, 60.9),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    trans = "log10",
    option = "viridis",
    name = expression(
      "NAEI 2023 total NH"[3] *
      "\nemissions value\nwithin 1 km"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression(
      "SAMHE schools and surrounding NAEI 2023 total NH"[3]~"emissions"
    ),
    subtitle = "School points coloured by extracted total NH3 emissions value within 1 km",
    caption = expression(
      "Values are NAEI gridded emissions context, not measured ambient NH"[3]~"concentration."
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

nh3_school_map

ggsave(
  file.path(
    ammonia_fig_dir,
    "SAMHE_schools_NAEI_total_NH3_1km_map.png"
  ),
  plot = nh3_school_map,
  width = 180,
  height = 220,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r map_naei_nh3_with_samhe_schools_clean}
# ---- ALTERNATIVE Map of NAEI total NH3 emissions with SAMHE schools ----
# Higher NH3 emissions are shown using darker colours.
# The colour scale is capped at 10 for display only.

library(rnaturalearth)

naei_total_nh3 <- naei_nh3_rasters[["total"]]

# ---- UK land boundary ----

uk_land <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  country = "United Kingdom",
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  st_transform(crs = terra::crs(naei_total_nh3))

uk_land_vect <- terra::vect(uk_land)

# ---- Crop and mask NAEI raster to UK land ----

naei_total_nh3_uk <- terra::crop(
  naei_total_nh3,
  uk_land_vect
)

naei_total_nh3_uk <- terra::mask(
  naei_total_nh3_uk,
  uk_land_vect
)

# ---- Convert raster to data frame ----

naei_total_nh3_df <- as.data.frame(
  naei_total_nh3_uk,
  xy = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

names(naei_total_nh3_df) <- c("x", "y", "nh3_value")

naei_total_nh3_df <- naei_total_nh3_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(nh3_value),
    nh3_value > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    nh3_value_plot = pmin(nh3_value, 10)
  )

# ---- SAMHE school locations ----

school_coordinates <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  select(
    SchoolId_short,
    SchoolLongitude,
    SchoolLatitude
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SchoolLongitude),
    !is.na(SchoolLatitude)
  ) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    SchoolLongitude = first(SchoolLongitude),
    SchoolLatitude = first(SchoolLatitude),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

school_coordinates_sf <- st_as_sf(
  school_coordinates,
  coords = c("SchoolLongitude", "SchoolLatitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

school_coordinates_bng <- st_transform(
  school_coordinates_sf,
  crs = terra::crs(naei_total_nh3)
)

# ---- Plot ----

nh3_raster_school_map_clean <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(
    data = naei_total_nh3_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = nh3_value_plot)
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = uk_land,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = school_coordinates_bng,
    shape = 21,
    size = 1,
    stroke = 0.2,
    colour = "grey20",
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    trans = "log10",
    limits = c(0.001, 10),
    oob = scales::squish,
    breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10),
    labels = c("0.001", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10"),
    name = expression("NAEI 2023 total NH"[3]~"emissions value")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression("NAEI 2023 total NH"[3]~"emissions with SAMHE schools"),
    subtitle = "Darker shading indicates higher NAEI gridded emissions; schools shown as white circles",
    caption = expression("NAEI NH"[3]~"values are emissions inventory grid values, not measured ambient concentrations. Colour scale capped at 10 for display.")
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(27700),
    xlim = c(-100000, 700000),
    ylim = c(0, 1250000),
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
```

```{r plot_naei_nh3_sector_boxplot_1km}
# ---- Boxplot of NAEI NH3 emissions by source sector ----
# Uses the 1 km buffer around each school.
# Excludes total because total includes summed sector emissions and point-source emissions.
# Values are emissions/source-pressure context, not measured ambient NH3 concentrations.

nh3_sector_boxplot_1km <- local({

  nh3_sector_plot_data <- school_ammonia_context_long %>%
    filter(
      buffer_km == 1,
      sector != "total",
      !is.na(nh3_emission_value),
      nh3_emission_value > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sector_label = dplyr::recode(
        sector,
        `02nonindustcomb` = "Non-industrial combustion",
        `03industcomb` = "Industrial combustion",
        `04prodprocess` = "Production processes",
        `06solvents` = "Solvents",
        `07roadtrans` = "Road transport",
        `08othertrans` = "Other transport",
        `09waste` = "Waste",
        `10agriculture` = "Agriculture",
        `11nature` = "Nature"
      )
    )

  nh3_sector_order <- nh3_sector_plot_data %>%
    group_by(sector_label) %>%
    summarise(
      median_value = median(nh3_emission_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(median_value)
    ) %>%
    pull(
      sector_label
    )

  nh3_sector_plot_data <- nh3_sector_plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      sector_label = factor(
        sector_label,
        levels = nh3_sector_order
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    nh3_sector_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = sector_label,
      y = nh3_emission_value
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      fill = "grey85",
      colour = "grey25",
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      alpha = 0.25,
      size = 0.6,
      colour = sheffield_purple
    ) +
    scale_y_log10(
      breaks = c(
        0.000001,
        0.00001,
        0.0001,
        0.001,
        0.01,
        0.1,
        1
      ),
      labels = c(
        "0.000001",
        "0.00001",
        "0.0001",
        "0.001",
        "0.01",
        "0.1",
        "1"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = expression("NAEI NH"[3]~"emissions within 1 km of SAMHE schools"),
      subtitle = "Source-sector comparison using 2023 NAEI gridded emissions",
      x = "NAEI source sector",
      y = expression("Mean NAEI 2023 NH"[3]~"emissions value within 1 km buffer"),
      caption = expression("Values are emissions/source-pressure context, not measured ambient NH"[3]~"concentration.")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )
})

ggsave(

  ),

  units = "mm",

)
```

```{r plot_school_hours_pm25_vs_nh3}
# ---- Relationship between classroom PM2.5 and NAEI NH3 emissions context ----
# Uses ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia.
# One point = one school.
# Primary outcome = mean school-hours classroom PM2.5.
# Only positive NH3 values are plotted because the x-axis is log-scaled.

nh3_pm25_correlation_plot <- local({

  required_variables <- c(
    "SchoolId_short",
    "period",
    "indoor_pm25_mean",
    "nh3_total_1km",
    "nh3_gridded_sector_sum_1km",
    "nh3_10agriculture_1km"
  )

  missing_variables <- setdiff(
    required_variables,
    names(ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia)
  )

  if (length(missing_variables) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required variable(s): ",
      paste(missing_variables, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  plot_data <- ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia %>%
    filter(
      period == "School hours"
    ) %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      indoor_pm25_mean,
      nh3_total_1km,
      nh3_gridded_sector_sum_1km,
      nh3_10agriculture_1km
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("nh3_"),
      names_to = "nh3_variable",
      values_to = "nh3_value"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
      is.finite(nh3_value),
      nh3_value > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      nh3_variable = dplyr::recode(
        nh3_variable,
        nh3_10agriculture_1km = "Agriculture NH3",
        nh3_gridded_sector_sum_1km = "Gridded sector NH3, excluding point sources",
        nh3_total_1km = "Total NH3, including point sources"
      ),
      nh3_variable = factor(
        nh3_variable,
        levels = c(
          "Agriculture NH3",
          "Gridded sector NH3, excluding point sources",
          "Total NH3, including point sources"
        )
      )
    )

  stats_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(
      nh3_variable
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      n_schools = n(),
      spearman_rho = cor(
        nh3_value,
        indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        use = "complete.obs"
      ),
      p_value = cor.test(
        nh3_value,
        indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      facet_label = paste0(
        nh3_variable,
        "\nSpearman rho = ",
        round(spearman_rho, 3),
        ", p = ",
        signif(p_value, 3),
        ", n = ",
        n_schools
      )
    )

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    left_join(
      stats_data %>%
        select(
          nh3_variable,
          facet_label
        ),
      by = "nh3_variable"
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = nh3_value,
      y = indoor_pm25_mean
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.5,
      colour = sheffield_purple
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      colour = "grey25",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ facet_label,
      scales = "free_x"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = expression("School-hours classroom PM"[2.5]~"and NAEI NH"[3]~"emissions context"),
      subtitle = "One point represents one school; NH3 variables use 1 km buffer means",
      x = expression("NAEI 2023 NH"[3]~"emissions context within 1 km buffer (log scale)"),
      y = expression("Mean school-hours classroom PM"[2.5]~"("*mu*"g m"^-3*")"),
      caption = expression("NH"[3]~"values are emissions/source-pressure context, not measured ambient NH"[3]~"concentrations. Only positive NH"[3]~"values are shown because the x-axis is log-scaled. Correlations are school-level Spearman rank correlations.")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )
})

nh3_pm25_correlation_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(
    ammonia_fig_dir,
    "school_hours_classroom_PM25_vs_NAEI_NH3_1km.png"
  ),
  plot = nh3_pm25_correlation_plot,
  width = 260,
  height = 160,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)
```


```{r plot_school_hours_pm25_vs_agriculture_nh3_buffers}
# ---- School-hours classroom PM2.5 versus agricultural NH3 at multiple buffers ----
# One point = one school.
# Tests whether the NH3-PM2.5 relationship changes with buffer size.

agri_nh3_pm25_buffer_plot <- local({

  plot_data <- ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia %>%
    filter(
      period == "School hours"
    ) %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      indoor_pm25_mean,
      nh3_10agriculture_1km,
      nh3_10agriculture_2km,
      nh3_10agriculture_5km,
      nh3_10agriculture_10km
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("nh3_10agriculture_"),
      names_to = "buffer",
      values_to = "nh3_value"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
      is.finite(nh3_value),
      nh3_value > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      buffer = dplyr::recode(
        buffer,
        nh3_10agriculture_1km = "1 km",
        nh3_10agriculture_2km = "2 km",
        nh3_10agriculture_5km = "5 km",
        nh3_10agriculture_10km = "10 km"
      ),
      buffer = factor(
        buffer,
        levels = c("1 km", "2 km", "5 km", "10 km")
      )
    )

  stats_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(buffer) %>%
    summarise(
      n_schools = n(),
      spearman_rho = cor(
        nh3_value,
        indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        use = "complete.obs"
      ),
      p_value = cor.test(
        nh3_value,
        indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      facet_label = paste0(
        buffer,
        "\nSpearman rho = ",
        round(spearman_rho, 3),
        ", p = ",
        signif(p_value, 3),
        ", n = ",
        n_schools
      )
    )

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    left_join(
      stats_data %>%
        select(buffer, facet_label),
      by = "buffer"
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = nh3_value,
      y = indoor_pm25_mean
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.5,
      colour = sheffield_purple
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      colour = "grey25",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ facet_label,
      scales = "free_x"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = expression("School-hours classroom PM"[2.5]~"and agricultural NH"[3]~"emissions context"),
      subtitle = "Agricultural NAEI 2023 NH3 tested using 1, 2, 5 and 10 km buffer means",
      x = expression("NAEI 2023 agricultural NH"[3]~"emissions context (log scale)"),
      y = expression("Mean school-hours classroom PM"[2.5]~"("*mu*"g m"^-3*")"),
      caption = expression("NH"[3]~"values are emissions/source-pressure context, not measured ambient NH"[3]~"concentrations. Only positive NH"[3]~"values are shown because the x-axis is log-scaled. Correlations are school-level Spearman rank correlations.")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),

      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )
})
```
